name: 21.QF2

origin.summary: Test 2 of the 2021 CrossFit Quarterfinals. The Quarterfinals sit between the worldwide Open and the Semifinals in the CrossFit Games season — a harder online stage for the top slice of Open finishers.

description: A descending triplet of GHD sit-ups, rope climbs, and alternating pistols.
